summary: Frontend-only testing for the Shred City rework (route /#/shred-legend). Verified PLAY menu order+rename, intro/header 'SHRED CITY', the per-note BEND bug fix (held voice gets a playbackRate ramp AFTER two quick taps), mash guard (4-key->TOO WILD!, 3-key clean), dev-hook meter tiers with tier flash banner + confetti burst + back row + camera flashes + crowd-surfer + pyro, home daily-quest-card regression, and Jam Session guitar BEND regression. No pageerror on intro/playing.
critical_code_review_comments: ShredLegendPage.js is 813 lines - consider splitting (CrowdRow/CrowdExtras/CameraFlashes are good extraction candidates). Maintainability only, not a bug.

Informational: idle decay (-0.5/100ms after 600ms idle) means a single dev-hook __shredSetMeter(22) decays below the 22 tier threshold within ~500ms, so shred-tier-label snaps back to the previous tier even though the shred-tier-flash correctly fires. In actual gameplay (continuous note input) this is a non-issue. For automated tests I pumped the hook 3x in quick succession to overcome decay; consider adding window.__shredSetMeter(v, { freeze: true }) to simplify future tests.
seed_data_creation: localStorage: jma_unlock_all_v1='1', jma_reveal_seen_v1='1', jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1' set after first navigation then reload (add_init_script timing was flaky with the audio-unlock overlay).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-32 Shred City criteria verified. Key gotcha: idle decay in ShredLegendPage runs at -0.5/100ms when no notes fired recently, so single dev-hook meter set will decay below tier thresholds within ~500ms. Pump __shredSetMeter(v) 3x with 60ms gap to verify tier labels; pump at v>=95 to see surfer/pyro. BEND fix verified by monkey-patching AudioParam.prototype.linearRampToValueAtTime via add_init_script and counting ramp calls after keydown('b') while holding '1' past two quick 3/5 taps (delta_on_b=2 in Shred City, 1 in Jam Session). All expected testids present. PLAY tile order confirmed: jelly-jukebox, shred-legend, stew-kazoo, note-match, detective-jellybone, sight-reading, robot-boogie.

test_results_detail.combo_multiplier_visuals: code path confirmed in ShredLegendPage.onGuitarPlay (combo>=3 shows shred-combo, >=6 shows x1.5 multiplier, >=12 shows x2 ON FIRE). Live tap-to-beat timing not reliably automatable (informational).
